audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 read Skill on both layers while mid calls it 'your most decisive spike in this matchup'; 2+ items read Riven while whys[6], spikes[3] and late all hand that stage to Warwick. Packet chart: Riven at 6, Warwick at 2+ items.
audit.why: 49.69% over 1292 games; the chart disagreed with its own prose in two rows.
audit.corrected: Level 6 -> Riven, 2+ items -> Warwick, as matched full/content pairs plus the 2+ items rating.

audit.why: Four spikes present and correctly ordered: Lvl 2-3 W stun, Lvl 6 Blade of the Exile, 1st item burst, 2+ items Warwick sustain.

audit.whatIsWrong: Primal Howl (E) is never mentioned anywhere in either layer, and Jaws of the Beast's max-health scaling is never stated. whys[4] and spikes[1] again call Wind Slash an execute.
audit.why: Primal Howl gives him 2.5s damage reduction and then a 1s flee on nearby enemies — it lands exactly inside your Q chain, both blunting your burst and walking you out of range. Q dealing max-health damage means armour stacking reads the trade wrong.
audit.corrected: Primal Howl: 15/14/13/12/11s, 375 range, damage reduction then a 1s fear. Jaws of the Beast: 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s, 365 range, max-health damage that heals him. Wind Slash is one ranged projectile per R, not a threshold execute.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: no cooldown-sequencing anywhere. Infinite Duress is tracked by name only and Primal Howl not at all.
audit.why: Primal Howl at 11-15s is the cooldown that actually decides whether your Q chain completes.
audit.corrected: whys[3] now names Primal Howl's 11-15s window as the trade timer for levels 4-5.

audit.why: Anti-heal is already treated as mandatory in mid, whys[5], wants.you[1] and the full-layer itemization — correct given his passive heals and triples below 25%.

edits.before: Levels 4-5: without anti-heal built yet this window is neutral, and extended trades will let his Q pull him back to safe HP, so keep trades short and decisive.
edits.after: Levels 4-5: Jaws of the Beast bites for max health so armour will not save you, and Primal Howl (11-15s) fears you out of the Q chain. Keep trades short.

edits.before: Level 6: Blade of the Exile lets you open from outside Infinite Duress charge range and Wind Slash at half-HP executes him before his Q heal gets a second tick off.
edits.after: Level 6: Blade of the Exile opens from outside Infinite Duress range, and Wind Slash is one ranged shot — spend it before Jaws of the Beast heals him back up.

edits.before: Blade of the Exile extends your melee range and Wind Slash executes him before his Q heal can top him up fast enough to survive.
edits.after: Blade of the Exile extends your melee range and Wind Slash is a ranged finisher — fire it before Jaws of the Beast tops him back up.

notes: The kit file derives a 'channel: interruptible — any CC cancels it' flag on Infinite Duress, but Riot's own description says only that he leaps and suppresses — no channel. Per the trust-the-description rule I did NOT write any claim that Ki Burst can cancel his R; that would be the single most dangerous line to get wrong here. Flagged for a human to verify. Full-layer prose carries mojibake em dashes on disk, so full-layer edits are limited to clean-ASCII enum fields.
